text: Gorehoof the Black is a Grimtotem tauren found in Grimtotem Village in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Goramosh's Strange Device drops from Goramosh in the Moonrest Gardens in the Dragonblight.
__NOTOC__ Gorerot is a flesh beast serving the Forsaken in the Battle for Gilneas City.

Gorefiend's Vigil is a wing of the Black Temple consisting of interior and exterior sections of the southern rampart, it is reached through the Sanctuary of Shadows. It is populated by orcs of the Shadowmoon clan. At the end is Teron Gorefiend with his Hand of Gorefiend bodyguards on a balcony overlooking the Sanctuary of Shadows.

Gorat is an orc assassin sent on a mission to find and eliminate the elf in charge of the assault on the Mor'shan Rampart. He and his group were, however, killed after the elven leader had been discovered. Before he dies he is able to give his final report and some of his blood to an adventurer to return to Kadrak. Dinah Halfmoon, using this blood, was able to imbue it which would allow Gorat's spirit to return to his body for a short duration. Upon returning to his body he quickly set out for his vengeance against the elven leader, thus completing his mission. Gorat shall forever be known as a hero of the Horde.
Goremaw's Bite is a Subtlety rogue ability, learned from Fangs of the Devourer.
__NOTOC__ Gor is a magnaron located in Frostfire Ridge. He was attacked by the Horde followers sent from Frostwall to get his hide that has magical properties.
Gorged Gear-Cruncher is a ranishu located on Mechagon Island.
Goodness Gracious is a quest achievement earned by activating 12 different Fel Runes within 6 seconds and live to tell the tale in Shattrath City.
Gorestream is an unbound water elemental located in Island Expeditions.
Gorgejaw the Glutton is a snake located in Island Expeditions.
Gordawg's Boulder is provided as an objective for Shattering the Veil.
Gorewrought Spellblade drops from Bloated Lootfly in Maldraxxus.
Gorefiend's Domination is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Gorefiend's Domination.
Gorewrought Shortsword drops from Bloated Lootfly in Maldraxxus.

Goren Burrowers are goren located in the Ascent of Frostfire and Bleeding Mountain in Frostfire Ridge. They also attack the Lunarfall and Frostwall garrisons during Garrison Invasions.
Gorben Highbrow is a Highmountain tauren seen speaking with Associate Telemancer Rafcav in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.

Gorillas are a species of ape found in Stranglethorn Vale, Feralas, Un'Goro Crater, Sholazar Basin, the Jade Forest, and Zandalar. They are typically to any travelers that come across them despite the fact that they are herbivores. An enormous gorilla named King Mukla dwells on Jaguero Island in southeast Stranglethorn Vale, holding a tauren named Princess Poobah captive. Young apes quickly learn to hang from branches with their feet, leaving both hands free to fling objects at interlopers. The gorillas at Gorilla Gorge in Zuldazar are highly intelligent due to the presence of kaja'mite.

__NOTOC__ Gracina Spiritmight is a night elf priest located in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She is an associate of something called the Protectorate. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Gorosh the Dervish is an elite orc warrior that sometimes appears in Blackrock Depths. When a player enters the Ring of Law in the Depths, an arena event will occur where players have to face three waves of non-elite enemies and finally an elite mini-boss. Gorosh is one of six possible mini-bosses that could appear. The other ones are Anub'shiah, Eviscerator, Grizzle, Hedrum the Creeper, and Ok'thor the Breaker. Gorosh hits very hard and has a devastating Mortal Strike attack.
Gorina is a level 30 mining vendor located in the Valley of Honor in the orcish city of Orgrimmar.
The Gracious Cape is a spellcaster's cloak that give a bonus to intellect as well as increases mana regeneration.
Gorrim is the flight master located at Emerald Sanctuary in the contested territory of Felwood.
Grace of the Mantis is a pet talent located in the 4th tier of the Tenacity tree.
Gothard Winslow is a Forsaken found in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.

Gorrok's Lament is a sunken Horde destroyer found in northeastern Kelp'thar Forest. The area is covered with sea snakes. Among the sea snakes is Akasha, a huge sea snake who swallowed a key needed to unlock The Horde's Hoard.
Gormungan is a mountain giant that stands along the rail track running between the Southern Rocketway Terminus and the Secret Lab in Azshara.
__NOTOC__ Gorgonite is a basilisk found almost due north of the Temple of Earth in the Shuddering Spires of Deepholm. His powers have become so great he can petrify Stone Bats and even a Son of Kor.
Grace of Air is a passive shaman ability, available at level 80. It grants a bonus to haste and mastery to party and raid members.
Graceful Jessi is a pandaren located at the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Gotri's Traveling Gear is a bag shop on the lower area of the Drag in Orgrimmar. It is the first shop encountered when players step from the Valley of Strength into the Drag.
Goss the Swift is a human flight master located at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest, standing near Marshal Patterson.
__NOTOC__ The Gorgrond Flytrap is a plant native to , notably Gorgrond. The ichor drawn from it is an essential component in creating Hexweave Cloth. It has a very pungent and "attacking" smell.
Gorr'thogg's Personal Reserve was found at / behind Gorr'thogg's throne on the top floor of Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge. Loot it for 7xOgre Moonshine and ~10x Garrison Resources.
__NOTOC__ Gotuun is the flight master located at Twilight Glade in .
Graedis Oenthar can be found in The Menagerie in the city of Suramar.
Gornoth the Lost is an enormous ettin wandering around the Witchwood in Highmountain. __NOTOC__
__NOTOC__ Gorilla Gorge is a subzone of Zuldazar on Zandalar. It is full of intelligent Da'kani gorillas that are empowered by the chunks of Kaja'mite that are erupting from the steam vents.
Gory Regeneration is an Azerite trait available to Guardian druids.

Gowzis is orc among the band of Horde refugees that were cared for by the apothecary Cotley. When they were approached by Visrynn, the dark ranger demanded that they take a vow of silence, to which they all agreed. While she traveled with them, Cotley tended to her injured hand and learned that she sought to go south and was charting a boat from Faldir's Cove. In time, an Alliance strike team led by Turalyon and Alleria Windrunner came upon them looking for Visrynn. Her son, Zun panicked and tried attacking the Alliance only to be stopped by Turalyon, and in fear for son's life she begged for him to be spared, which they accepted. With the powers of the void, Alleria was able to sense that G

Gorm Sacs are found at Tirna Scithe in Ardenweald. Picking them up grants a temporary ability called Gormones which will cause nearby gorm to fight amongst themselves for 20 seconds, increasing their haste as well.
Gorian Sorcerers are ogres located in Highmaul. They also appear in the version of Highmaul. Upon approach, they teleport the player away.

Gothra the Trembler is a charred behemoth serving as the boss of the Venthyr Assault at the Tremaculum in the Maw. Players cannot normally attack the behemoth, but they can redirect the Light through four mirrors to destroy it.
Gothal is a tauren located at Zen'shiri Trading Post in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Gornbroad Sharpeye is a Highmountain tauren sneaking around the Drag in Orgrimmar.

The Grain Caravan was used by the Scourge to infect more villagers with the Plague of Undeath in Hearthglen. Arthas destroyed this caravan and helped stop the plague before Uther came in with reinforcements to Hearthglen. It looked similar to/was a Meat Wagon.
__NOTOC__ Graham Van Talen is a Forsaken located in the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity.
The Grand Crusader's Helm is a Level 42 quality Plate Helmet that improves Strength, Stamina and Dodge.
Grand Marshal's Tome of Power is an epic off-hand that can be purchased as a reward from PvP.
Grand Warlock Nethekurse, a fel orc warlock, is the first boss of the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
Grand Warlock's Amulet drops from Grand Warlock Nethekurse in the Shattered Halls.

.]] Grand Commander Ruusk is an Eclipsion blood elf located at Eclipse Point in Shadowmoon Valley. He is very tall. He is involved in the quest What Illidan Wants, Illidan Gets.... While he is normally hostile and can be killed, there is no quest to do so.
Grand Hamlet is the third mission of the Orc campaign in Warcraft: Orcs & Humans. The orcs continue their conquest of human territories by destroying Grand Hamlet.
Grand Black War Mammoth is a Feats of Strength achievement earned for learning to ride a Grand Black War Mammoth, a rare mount drop from the Vault of Archavon.

Grand Ambassador Flamelash is a mini-boss found in the Chamber of Enchantment in Blackrock Depths. He is accesible through a portal during the pre-Cataclysm event when a city is successfully defended from invasion. He is one of four of Cho'gall's Lieutenants

.]] The Grand Magister is the title traditionally held by the leader of the Thalassian magisters. It is an extremely high and prestigious rank to hold in Quel'Thalas, above even the Ranger-general of Silvermoon. Like the ranger-general, the grand magister is an elected position. The individual bearers of the title style themselves as the "Grand Magister of Quel'Thalas." The title was once held by Grand Magister Belo'vir, a renowned magus who was elected several years before the Third War, who was slain during the Scourge invasion of Quel'Thalas. Following the war and the rise of the blood elves, Archmage Rommath became his successor. Under his leadership, the magisters retained their high po

The Grain Warehouse was a large storage facility filled with infected grain. It was guarded by an abomination, and several smaller undead. They, along with the warehouse, were destroyed by Arthas Menethil and his force.
__NOTOC__ Grand Magister Reglakk is a Gorian Empire ogre found at Mar'gok's Overwatch in . He is the superior of Crulgorosh and worked on the project of imbuing armor with felbreaker magic.

__NOTOC__ Grand Vizier Jarasum is an eredar located at the Conservatory of the Arcane in Eredath. As one of Archimonde's greatest pupils, Jarasum held such power in his own disciplines that the Conservatory remembers him even centuries later. He must be defeated in order in order for Army of the Light to advance their quest to obtain the Sigil of Awakening.
Grand Inquisitors are inquisitors located in Azsuna, Highmountain, and Val'sharah during the Legion Assaults.
Grand Marshal Fury is a human located in Shatterstone Harbor in Vol'dun during Faction Assaults.
Grain Sacks are located in Highmountain and Stormsong Valley.
Grandmaster's Cypher is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Grandmaster's Ultimatum is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

The Granary Jug is provided for The Riddle of the Land. Using it teleports the player to the Imperial Granary in the Valley of the Four Winds.

__NOTOC__ Gralebboih is a gorm located at various locations in the Maw during a Tormentors of Torghast event. Gralebboih uniquely drops the Amaranthine Stinger, a flying gorm battle pet, and Gormhide Pauldrons.

Graktho the Automa-eater is a mutated devourer worldeater that spawns at the summit of the Resonant Peaks in Zereth Mortis during You Light Up My Life. Upon arrival, it pulls Pocopoc toward itself, and the player needs to collect the Cosmic Orbs created by Graktho's "Crush of the Infinite" ability and give them to Pocopoc in order to let them escape. Despite being , Graktho will ignore the player even if they try to attack it, allowing for safe collection of the orbs.

Grank the Rat is a critter on the Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne night elf campaign chapter 4, Wrath of the Betrayer. He is hidden at a small garden to the west of the northern Naga base that requires Maiev Shadowsong to Blink to. Like Filson the Rat, Grank cannot be killed with normal attacks and is magic immune, and must be clicked on repeatedly until he explodes. Killing Grank yields a Talisman of Evasion.

Graveyard zerging is the act of overwhelming an enemy (usually a world boss) by having players immediately run back to their corpse and resurrect during a battle, rather than use any sort of strategy or skill in the battle. The point is to keep a neverending stream of players attacking a target until it's dead. This was once a major problem with the world bosses, but Blizzard's solution was to give players a 15-minute debuff when they die which freezes/sleeps the player if they get too close to the World Boss. The Four Dragons and Azuregos had this feature. Lord Kazzak becomes nearly immortal after 3 minutes of battle, and is healed each time he kills a player. Unlike vanilla world bosses, g
Grappler's Belt is a leather belt that gives bonuses to strength and stamina.
__NOTOC__ Great Goretusks are boars found in the Redridge Mountains.
Grawnal is an orc general goods vendor located in Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains.

The Great Bulwarks can be found in the mountains near Grim Batol. They are series of interlocking peaks with an incredibly high metal ore content. The ley line pattern of this area makes them utterly impassable - all things, from lava flows to storms to travelers must pass around the Great Bulwarks, for they cannot pass through or over them. It is from this ley line pattern that the Shielding Pattern is derived.
__NOTOC__ Gravis Slipknot is a rare mob human found at Strahnbrad in the Alterac Mountains, north of Hillsbrad Foothills. He is a member of the Syndicate.

Grandpa Vishas is a human found with Nancy Vishas in a house on the shore of Lordamere Lake in the Alterac Mountains. He has not been seen since the Cataclysm, having likely been slain by adventurers in lore, and the house where he lived in is now empty.

.]] The Great Gate (or the Mulgore Gates) is a tauren fortification constructed at the entrance to their homeland of Mulgore, separating it from the Southern Barrens in response to the Alliance's destruction of the nearby Camp Taurajo, as well as to shelter the tribes in the wake of the Cataclysm. The Northwatch forces have setup several siege weapons near the gate in order to destroy it, but they were repelled by the tauren of Vendetta Point and Warlord Bloodhilt, an orcish general sent by Garrosh Hellscream. After the death of Deathwing, Northwatch soldiers were still stationed at the other side of the gate. Tauren and Darkspear tribe trolls led by Vol'jin and a reluctant Baine attacked th

The Great Divide is a huge lava-filled chasm created by the Cataclysm as a result of Deathwing's return. It sundered the Barrens in two and now serves as the dividing line between the Northern and Southern Barrens. During the Fourth War, the Horde installed goblin :Azerite cannons on the northern shore of the Great Divide in order to counter the firepower of Northwatch Hold.

These palm-sized clay discs are sold by the dozen. They can either be laid as traps for the unwary, or thrown to crack open at the desired area. When a grease mine is shattered, the grease inside the disc spreads to cover a five feet square.
Grasp is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
__NOTOC__ Grayson Ironwing is a dwarf flight master located at Northpass Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Gravity is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Gavrax the Destructor is an ered'ruin of the Burning Legion. He was first seen at the Battle for the Broken Shore, standing at the way back of the Legion forces that appear near close to the end of the battle. He then appeared at Garden of the Moon in Val'sharah. Presumably, he is the leader of the assault on the Temple of Elune. He is the only obvious agent of the Legion in Val'sharah. His death is not required for the main storyline, but he does drop a quest item that leads to a reward.
Graveyard Rats are rat critters that can be found in the tunnels beneath Gilneas City leading into Aderic's Repose in Gilneas.
__NOTOC__ Gravely Wounded Moonfall Defender is a night elf located in Suramar.
Grapeshot Grenades were sold for by Durkis and Zuna during Island Expeditions.
Great Eagles are eagles located in Highmountain during Legion Assaults and on the Broken Shore.
Great-father Winter's Helper is a goblin standing next to Great-father Winter in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar during the Feast of Winter Veil.
Greasemonkey Muscles are goblins located in Prospectus Bay on Mechagon Island.
Greasetrap is a deep sea murloc located in Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island.
The Grease Prospector is a Mechagon mechagnome located at the Heaps on Mechagon Island. He is inspecting a pool of polluted mud with his Grease Pail. The mud is home to the Foul Manifestation.
Grease Pail is located at the Heaps on Mechagon Island. It is following a Grease Prospector around a pool of polluted mud, containing the Foul Manifestation.
Greasemonkey Union Reps are goblins located in the Great Seal atop Dazar'alor as well as on Mechagon Island.
__NOTOC__ Greasemonkey Laborers are goblins located in Dazar'alor and on Mechagon Island.
The Greasy Eel is a goblin submarine captained by Captain Krooz. Thanks to Ricket, it came to Dazar'alor and was used by Gazlowe's Greasemonkeys to get to Mechagon Island.
Great Brown Dragon Turtles are dragon turtles located in Stormwind City and Orgrimmar. In the Vision of Orgrimmar, one is found dead.
Grasping Tendrils is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Grawlash the Frenzied is a furbolg located in Island Expeditions.
Gravity Dynamo is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Graven Winds is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

__NOTOC__ Grateful Boon is found atop a grassy area in the mountains of south-western Zereth Mortis. Once all the agitated wildlife in the area are calmed, Tah Fen will spawn and grant access to the treasure.

Greater Tarantulas are tarantulas found in the Redridge Mountains.

Greater Timberstriders are tallstrider mobs that can be found northeast of the Exodar and in the areas surrounding Stillpine Hold on Azuremyst Isle. According to Huntress Kella Nightbow, these powerful birds are often underestimated by predators—with dire results.
__NOTOC__ Greater Felfire Diemetradons are diemetradons found in Shadowmoon Valley.

Greatmother Icemist is the wife of the High Chieftain of the taunka, Roanauk Icemist, and mother of Banthok Icemist. She starts the Strength of Icemist quest chain, where she asks the player to find her son who traveled to Icemist Village to find his father. She appears inside Agmar's Hammer after you complete the quest From the Depths of Azjol-Nerub

In the woods of Darkshore reside three great spirits, that of the Stag, that of the Thistle Bear, and that of the Moonstalker.

Great White Plainshawks are flying high above Thunderfoot Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
The Great Wheel is the power behind everything done at the Stormstout Brewery. The room mostly contains the spirits of Stormstouts of generations past.
Great Sea Whale Sharks can be found in the Great Sea off the shores of Suramar. They sometimes swim up to the canals of the city.
Greater Pyroblast is a Fire mage PvP talent, a stronger version of Pyroblast which serves as a separate ability and does not replace or otherwise affect the original.
Greater Power For Greater Threats is a breadcrumb quest for characters that did not already have all 35 artifact traits unlocked prior to patch 7.2.0.
Greatfather may refer to: * Greatfather Winter * Great-father Winter * Greatfather Winter (Highmountain) * Greatfather Kobold * Greatfather Aldrimus * Greatfather Mahan
Greatmother Hodiin is a vision of a tauren located in Highmountain. He appears upon interacting with the Ancient Spirit Drum.

.]] The Great Mead Hall is the spacious southern wing of Skyhold, the legendary home of the Valarjar. The hall is used both as a living quarters for the armies of Valarjar that reside in the Halls of Valor, as well as a seat of power for Odyn himself, a principal god of the vrykul. The mead hall is constantly filled with the revelry of many aspirants, shieldmaidens, and stormforged, and is well stocked with food and drink. Along with the Hall of Glory elsewhere in the Halls of Valor, the Great Mead Hall acts a throne room for Odyn, and important ceremonies are often conducted here.

The Great Reindeers are stag found in Ironforge and Orgrimmar. Led by the Red-Nosed Reindeer they pull Greatfather Winter's Sleigh around their city. All the reindeers as well as the sleigh itself can be ridden.
The Greathelm of Phantasmic Reality drops from N'Zoth the Corruptor in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

Great Worms From Beyond are massive serpents of N'Zoth located over Uldum and Vale of Eternal Blossoms during Assaults. Flying too close will apply a stacking debuff; Great Worm's Foul Stench, causing damage and slowing mount speed.
Great Huntsman is a tarantula located in Island Expeditions.
Great Sting is a pet battle ability used primarily by insects.
__NOTOC__ Gregory Charles is a Forsaken rogue trainer located in the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity. He is also found in the Hall of Shadows. He duels with Lord Tony Romano.
Green Hakkari Bijou is a small token of power from the mobs in Zul'Gurub.

__NOTOC__ Gregan Brewspewer is a dwarf located in a small camp just west of the road south of the Twin Colossals in Feralas. He is an expert in herbs and alchemy. He used to live in Ironforge, but prefers the peacefulness of the forest to living in a big city. He is friends with the Marshal Expeditions member Muigin. He is friendly to both Horde and Alliance. Muigin sent adventurers to Gregan for help with studying the bloodpetal plants of Un'Goro Crater. Donova Snowden sent adventurers to Gregan to ask him to brew a Videre elixir, which was necessary in the quest to improve Linken's sword. To make the elixir, Gregan needed an :Evoroot plant, guarded by Miblon Snarltooth. He sold the adventu

The Greatwood Vale is a forested valley in the foothills of the Stonetalon Mountains. It is accessible via Webwinder Path. The Horde settlement of Malaka'jin is to the south, and the Alliance settlement of Northwatch Expedition Base Camp is to the north.
Green Iron Leggings is mail legs for Warriors or Paladins and adds 8 Stamina and Strength to the user.

The Green Belt is an area of the eastern Wetlands where the trees and shrubs grow especially thick and where swamp flowers bloom all year around. Rethiel the Greenwarden makes his home here behind a hill, and where he treads, plants spring to life and blossoms flourish. The Green Belt is also home to crocolisks, bog beasts, and oozes. A wrecked Dragonmaw clan caravan can be found here with red whelps, implying it was destroyed in the aftermath of the Battle of Grim Batol. In the years leading up to the Cataclysm, an Alliance town has sprung up around Rethiel, the Greenwarden, called Greenwarden's Grove. The surrounding area has been affected by flooding and other unusual phenomenon which has

Druids from Azeroth come to Outland and in a few, rare places manage to re-grow healthy foliage in the sickened soil. These realms are lush and verdant, a window into Draenor's past when it was a thriving, green world. Travelers speak of unique creatures in these areas, magically evolved to adapt to the new environment.
The Green Wind Rider can be purchased for from the following vendors: * in Hellfire Peninsula * in Shadowmoon Valley * in Orgrimmar * in Dalaran * in Borean Tundra
The Green Voodoo Feathers were part of a set imbued with a rare magic able to turn the evil of something against itself.

The Greengill Coast is a stretch of coast inhabited by the murloc Greengill tribe who have established a village along the coast where they have built many homes and huts. The Greengill Coast can be found on the southeastern part of the Isle of Quel'Danas. Unfortunately, the Darkspine naga have invaded the murloc village and the Darkspine Sirens have mind-controlled the murlocs into their slaves. However, not all hope is lost for the Greengill tribe. Captain Valindria, who resides on the ship, Silvermoon's Pride in the harbor of Sun's Reach, offers a quest to adventurers to retrieve the orbs that the sirens use to control the murlocs.
Greer Orehammer is is the flight master located at Westguard Keep in the contested territory of Howling Fjord.
Greaves of the Blue Flight drop from Ormorok the Tree-Shaper in the Nexus on normal mode.

Green Island is a giant sea turtle used as transportation between Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight and Kamagua in the Howling Fjord. He has a roomy wooden deck and a cargo hold built upon his shell. The turtle is crewed by two tuskarr, one of which is busy making sure the turtle does not eat the carrots used for steering. No loading screen occurs during the trip.
Green Wedding Hanbok is sold by Geenia Sunshadow in Moonglade for .

The Green Brewfest Stein can be filled at a Brewfest Festive Keg, becoming a , and then can be used to drink the brew. Filling, hence drinking, is free, and the brews are both alcoholic (inebriating) and provide mana restoration and a well fed buff. Although originally without an associated achievement, having obtained it will now provide the Feat of Strength .

Green Drakonid can be found in Nefarian's Lair inside Blackwing Lair. Drakonid from two random dragonflights (red, blue, green, bronze, or black), as well as Chromatic Drakonid, will spawn during phase one of the Nefarian encounter.
Greenwarden's Grove is a night elven outpost and quest hub, complete with a flight path. Rethiel the Greenwarden remains here as a quest giver.
The Green Balloon is sold by: * in Dalaran * in Stormwind City * in Orgrimmar
Greench's Gift is an ability used by Rotten Little Helper during a Pet Battle.

Green Dragon Turtles are dragon turtles located at the Temple of Five Dawns in Wandering Isle, handled by Li the Tamer, in the Jade Temple Grounds in the Jade Forest, Pang's Stead and Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds, and Stormwind City.
Greenbelly's Raiders are a Horde team that can be encountered on Island Expeditions. They can also be found idling in the Port of Zandalar along with the other teams.

Green Paint Filled Bladder drops from the Crazed Trogg on Mechagon Island. They can also be created with a Dredged Leather Bladder or looted from Balloon Boxes in Zskera Vaults in the Forbidden Reach.
Greaves of the Twilight Drake drop from Vexiona in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Greenskin's Wickers is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Greenskin.
Greaves of Shattered Thoughts drops from Grand Empress Shek'zara in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
The following are members of the green dragonflight, from both in-game and novels.

The Greymane Wall was erected before the Third War by order of King Genn Greymane, as the kingdom of Gilneas isolated itself from the Alliance and the rest of the world due to a disagreement surrounding the internment camps for the orcs, and other disputes. It is a colossal wall with a substantially sized gate, located at the southern edge of the Silverpine Forest in Lordaeron (its entrance near Pyrewood Village) and the northern edge of the Gilnean peninsula. The controversial edifice led to the rise of tensions among the people of Gilneas, but protected the Gilneans from the Plague and the Scourge invasion. Gretchen Vogel is a human food and drink vendor located in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains.

The Grim Guzzler is located deep inside Blackrock Depths. It is part of Shadowforge City, and lies just beyond the Manufactory and before the Chamber of Enchantment. The tavern is a large two-level area filled with mostly inebriated patrons. These patrons should remain neutral to adventurers unless they are aggravated. According Mathias Shaw, the Grim Guzzler and his Brewfest alone are worth a detour in the depths of the world. There are also several named NPCs in the Grim Guzzler: * is the owner and barkeep who sells a few interesting items, including rare recipes. * is Plugger's succubus barmaid who secretly loves Private Rocknot. * the golem broods in a corner. Grillok "Darkeye" is the most powerful of the Bleeding Hollow clan's dark shaman residing in the Outland. He is involved as a target in the Horde quest Grillok "Darkeye", and located in a cave at the foothills of Zeth'Gor.
Grennik is the flight master located at Stormspire in the territory of Netherstorm.

Gri'lek the Wanderer is an ancient tablet that tells the tale of Gri'lek, a hero of the trolls in ancient times. The tablet is currently located deep underwater off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale, in an area now known as the Vile Reef due to a murloc infestation. The troll city that once stood proudly there sunk long ago during an earthquake. Now the Darkspear tribe, trolls loyal to Thrall and the Horde, seek to recover the sacred tablet. Adventurous members of the Horde may wish to stop by Grom'gol Base Camp and talk to Kin'weelay to learn more (see The Vile Reef (quest) for the quest). The Alliance has also expressed interest in this particular legend. Brother Nimetz of the Rebel Camp in
__NOTOC__ Gretchen Fenlow is a human quest giver located near the gates of Stormwind City in Elwynn Forest.

Gren Tornfur is a furbolg located in Blackwood Hold in southern Darkshore. During the War of the Thorns, Gren Tornfur was rescued by the Alliance as the Horde marched in. By the time of the Battle for Darkshore, he had been consumed by dark magic and corrupted.
Greypaw is the timber wolf pet of Alma Deering located in the Command Center at Old Town in Stormwind City.
Gremlock's School of Caterers is a school led by Gremlock Pilsnor teaching the trade of cooking. Earning a Platinum Star grade awards the students with one of the Honorary Chef's Cleaver.

comic.]] The Greyfang Enclave, previously the Silver Enclave, is the Alliance district of Dalaran and the headquarters of the Silver Covenant, a group of high elves opposing the inclusion of the blood elves into the Kirin Tor, and serving as a military deterrent for any potential Horde uprising. The area is home to class trainers for all classes, city portals, and a mailbox. Portals for the Sanctum of Light and the Netherlight Temple, Order Halls of the Knights of the Silver Hand and the Conclave, are present inside with some paladins and priests of both orders present around. Greystone Enclave is a cave found in Greystone of Highmountain.
__NOTOC__ Greta Stonebrow is a dwarven innkeeper found at Nesingwary's Retreat in Highmountain.
__NOTOC__ Greystone Basilisks are basilisks found at Mountainfoot Strip Mine in Azshara. They have turned goblin miners into stone.
Greymane's Pride is a destroyer located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in .

The Greystone are a group of drogbar inhabiting Highmountain. They have an army based in the town of Greystone Enclave and nearby caves of Greystone. They later take over the Crystal Fissure during questing. They share space with the Bitestone tribe.
Greyguards are humans located next to Genn Greymane in Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City and later in the Harbormaster's Office in Boralus. They appear to be elite guards of the Greymane family.
Greystone Flankers are drogbar attacking Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Greystone Shardcasters are drogbar attacking Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Greystone Shardmaster is a drogbar located in Highmountain. They summon Rogg Shards.
Grieving Citizens are humans located at the Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City. They are mourning their dead.

The Greyseer pale is a group of pale orcs who dwell in the chasms of the Underpale. One day, came to their home and made alliance with the pale, teaching them the ways of the void and how to enslave elements. Led by Greyseer, these pale managed to enslave a few fire, air and earth elementals, as well as the earth fury himself, Gordawg. After the demise of their leader and the death of K'ure, Cho'gall takes control of the pale and uses them to attack Highmaul. They cause trouble all around the city but are ultimately defeated by the forces of Azeroth. It is unknown what happened to them after the death of Cho'gall.

Greystone Relief is a mountainous area in which an encampment is located, just outside the walls of Greystone Keep in the far east of Tiragarde Sound. The camp was set up by the survivors of a mutiny within the nearby keep, and these loyalists continue to seek to defeat the traitors in the name of House Proudmoore.

Greystone Keep is a large stronghold located just southeast of Boralus and north of Bridgeport in Tiragarde Sound. The keep sits on a large set of mountains that rise high above the Kul Tiran capital, and which grant it a sweeping view of the surrounding area. Traditionally controlled by House Proudmoore, Greystone serves as the first line of defense for Boralus's great seagate, and thus the capital itself.
Grievous was a level 7 affix for Mythic+. This affix was retired with the start of Dragonflight Season 2.
Greusel Grimecheek is a goblin located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
Grim Tinder is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

The Greystone Ruins are some ruins found slightly northeast and very close to Greystone Keep. It is unknown what this structure was used for, or how it was destroyed, though it is likely the ruined tower was used to watch over the the ships entering the bay area in front of Boralus.

Gresit is a venthyr located in the Absolution Crypt of Revendreth. He is a new venthyr sired by the Accuser. His mortal name was "Kranoid Felligri". After being sired, he seems to have become the Accuser's assistant, perhaps even apprentice, aiding in the redemption of souls in Sinfall, the Halls of Atonement, and during the atonement rituals option of the Ember Court. Gresit later aids the Accuser during the Venthyr Assault on the the Maw, seizing worthy souls from the Jailer's clutches. He appears to be magically floating and wearing a coat similar to his mistress.
Grim Inquisitor's Dread Calling is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Grim Inquisitor.
Grievous Bite is a special pet ability available exclusively to the Lizard family of hunter pets, reducing the effects of healing on the target by 50%.
Grinkle is a goblin quest giver located in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He is only available before and during the weekly Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza.
Mountaineer Gringer Stormpike is a dwarf quest giver located in Algaz Station in Loch Modan. He has little love for Moira.

Grimtotem Post is the base of Grimtotem tribe operations in Stonetalon Mountains. Many different types, such as Brutes, Ruffians, Sorcerers, and Mercenaries patrol the post and nearby areas. The Grimtotem here are led by the fierce Grundig Darkcloud.
Grimtotem Brutes are Grimtoten tauren found at Grimtotem Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
Grimtotem Mercenaries are Grimtotem tauren found at Grimtotem Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
Grimtotem Ruffians are tauren shaman found at Grimtotem Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
Grimtotem Sorcerers are tauren found at Grimtotem Post in the Stonetalon Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Grimungous is a rare mountain giant found in the Hinterlands.
The Grinding Quarry is located at the bottom Blackrock Mountain, below the Molten Span.
An item used to teach a Warlock's Doomguard the Cripple ability.
Grimoire of Intercept (Rank 1) teaches rank 1 of Intercept (felguard ability) for the warlock's felguard.
__NOTOC__ Grimwing is the flight master located at Acherus: The Ebon Hold when it is in Eastern Plaguelands, and later above The Broken Shore.

The Grindgear Toy Gorilla is a toy sold by the following vendors for : * in Dalaran * in Dalaran * in Stormwind City * in Orgrimmar It can also be found inside the Stolen Present and Stolen Gift during Feast of Winter Veil.

Grimoire of Supremacy is a warlock talent, available at level 75. When talented, a Warlocks usual summoned minions are replaced by more powerful demons. *Summon Fel Imp replaces Summon Imp *Summon Wrathguard replaces Summon Felguard (Demonology only) *Summon Voidlord replaces Summon Voidwalker *Summon Shivarra replaces Summon Succubus *Summon Observer replaces Summon Felhunter *Summon Abyssal replaces Summon Infernal *Summon Terrorguard replaces Summon Doomguard

Grindle Dopplegink is a gnomish recovery specialist located in Dalaran during its stay in Deadwind Pass. The entire city had been moved by a giant :Blink spell, and some Dalaran Citizens were re-materialized at the wrong place and were stuck in walls or in various other objects. Grindle was trying to help one of them.

Grimwing the Devourer was a formidable demon and the strongest of the felbats of Felsoul Hold, and was considered a suitable test of skill by Lyana Darksorrow. An order hall leader placed freshly-carved basilisk meat at her altar, and slayed her when she appeared. Her head was then brought to Lyana. She had massive fangs. Her lifeless head dripping with fel blood was described as the stuff of nightmares, and her petrified fel heart pulsed with fel magic rather than blood.
The Vilefiend Skull is a quest reward from Overwhelming Power (quest).
The Grimoire of Phase Shift teaches Phase Shift (imp ability) to the warlock's imp
Grimtotem Destroyers are tauren fighting Theramore Highway Guards in Dustwallow Marsh.
Grips of Occult Reminiscence drops from Shad'har the Insatiable in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Grimebreeze is a bound air elemental located in Island Expeditions.
The Grips of Power dropped from Kyrak in Upper Blackrock Spire during the Iron Horde Incursion.
Grip of the Everlasting is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of an Everlasting Grip.
Grimoire of Anguish (Rank 1) teaches rank 1 of Anguish (felguard ability) for the warlock's felguard.

Grimhowl is a red darkhound found in Shadowforge City in Blackrock Depths, and its trainer is Kasea Angerforge. Dark Iron dwarves can bond with it during Good Fiery Boy, at which point they can obtain it as a mount.
Grimoire of Cleave (Rank 1) teaches rank 1 of Cleave (felguard ability) for the warlock's felguard.
Grimoire of Avoidance teaches Avoidance (felguard ability) for the warlock's felguard.
Grimoire of Tainted Blood (Rank 1) teaches rank 1 of Tainted Blood (felhunter ability) to the warlock's felhunter.

Grom'gol Base Camp (or Grom'Gol) is an orcish camp on the southwestern coast of Northern Stranglethorn. Led by Commander Aggro'gosh, the outpost provides a safe chain of supply to Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows. This fort is heavily strengthened to be able to guard against jungle trolls, naga, and the many members of the Alliance who arrive from Booty Bay and Duskwood. The Savage Coast Raptor Fields are just to the north. During the war against the Zandalari, the camp was attacked by the Gurubashi trolls led by Bloodlord Mandokir. The attack was successfully repelled.
Griselda Blackhand was the daughter of Blackhand the Destroyer. She was killed by Blackhand's soldiers during the First War as punishment for running off with the renegade ogre Turok.

Grizzlemaw is a furbolg city located in the center of the Grizzly Hills of Northrend, built within the stump of the failed World Tree Vordrassil. The furbolgs of Grizzlemaw are all hostile, and are part of the Redfang and Frostpaw tribes, which are constantly at war. Killing furbolgs from one side can make you temporarily neutral with the other for five minutes (unless you kill more of the opposition, in which case you may remain so as long as you're nearby).

Grizzlepaw Ridge is a mountainous area located south of Thelsamar and east of Stonesplinter Valley in the dwarven territory of Loch Modan. It is inhabited by a large pack of bears, and most notably, the ferocious Ol' Sooty, who occasionally wanders down from his lair to the base of the valley, pouncing upon anyone unfortunate to irritate him. Gorick Guzzledraught is also here.
Grondal Moonbreeze was a tailoring trainer located in Auberdine. When the Cataclysm struck, he tried to escape the destruction but ended up dying on the nearby beach.
Gromden is a draenei banker located at the northwestern Terrace of Light bank in Shattrath City.
Grizzled Boots are leather boots that give a bonus to both strength and stamina.

This item is a quest reward from the quest The Cipher of Damnation (quest). The objective of this quest is to use The Cipher of Damnation at the Altar of Damnation to summon , and then destroy him. Speak to Earthmender Torlok, also found at the Altar of Damnation, when you are finished.

Gro'ach the Wise is an ogre barbarian. He is the leader and commander-in-chief of the Duskbelch tribe. He is an accomplished warrior and a respected chieftain. He is known for his leadership abilities.
__NOTOC__ Grom'thar the Thunderbringer is a powerful magnataur found near the Path of the Titans in the Dragonblight. Dregmar Runebrand says that Grom'thar commands many magnataur clans.
Grisy Spicecrackle is a goblin located in the Lower City, next to her master The Rokk and her colleague Gargoth.
Grizzik was an arakkoa living in Terokkar Forest during the Alliance invasion of Draenor. He and his brethren had fought the Horde alongside draenei in Shadowmoon Valley.
Grips of the Failed Immortal are a world drop from Cataclysm mobs.
Grisly Trophies are gained by killing appropriate-level monsters with a Darkmoon Adventurer's Guide in your inventory.
__NOTOC__ Grookin Flapmaster is a hozen flight master located at Grookin Hill in the Jade Forest.

Grondo is a gronn that stalks the Cracking Plains in Frostfire Ridge. He is described as a mad gronn that has been killing entire herds of clefthoof and devouring frostwolves, while moving ever closer to Frostwall. Furthermore, he is known to have attacked an alchemist's wagon and imbibed a large number of strength potions, which may be the cause of his wild rage.

The Grizzled Frostwolf Veteran at northeast of Stonefang Outpost overlooking The Boneslag starts a vignette: fending off three waves of three Thunderlord Crag-Leapers which climb up the mountainside, coming to claim his hut. Once they've been fended off, open the Dusty Chest to find the Frostwolf Veteran's Keepsake and the Faded Note, which reveals that the veteran has a deceased wife and a son.
Grizzled Grenadiers are level 90 goblins found north of the Dreadmaul Post and the Shattered Landing in the Blasted Lands.
